title: artifact_update body
description: A new version of an artifact shared with latest: true, from the offer's sender (spec/protocol.md section 5.21). Continues the offer's exchange. Comes with the feature artifacts.

blobs.description: The blob's parts, in order, when the ciphertext is over 64 MiB: blob is then the whole, and its id the first part's.

access.description: What the receiver may do from now on, when it changes; otherwise what the offer, or the latest update that said, gave.

latest.description: An update goes only to a share that follows the latest version.
